title: Multiplayer Characters
doc: Characters offered in multiplayer: name, screen names per language, portrait, entity class, team skins and per-weapon first person arms.

sections.name: #Characters
sections.doc: Each entry starts at $Name:; the list ends at #End.

fields.name: $ScreenName:

children.name: En:
children.doc: English screen name; the game searches ahead for En: and skips anything before it.

children.name: Gr:
children.doc: German screen name (searched for like En:).

children.name: Fr:
children.doc: French screen name (searched for like En:).

fields.doc: Marker without a value; the three language lines follow.

fields.name: $ImageName:
fields.doc: Portrait bitmap shown in the character list.

fields.name: $EntityType:
fields.doc: Entity class (entity.tbl) the player spawns as.

fields.name: $EntityAnimType:
fields.doc: Entity class whose animations are used.

fields.name: $SkinName:
fields.doc: Skin base name; the game looks for <name>_red / <name>_blue textures for teams.

fields.name: +Custom Fpgun:
fields.doc: First person arms for one weapon: weapon name, then an fpgun.tbl entry name.
